title: Never Have I Ever Generator - General Questions
meta_description: Generate a light, general-audience Never Have I Ever statement for conversations and voluntary group games.
intro: Pick one light Never Have I Ever statement from a built-in list.

sections.h2: How do I play Never Have I Ever?
sections.content: Choose a response method before starting, such as raising a hand or keeping a point. Click Generate and let participants respond only if they want to.

sections.h2: Are these statements suitable for every group?
sections.content: They are written for a general audience, but no list fits every age, culture, workplace, or classroom. Read the statement first and re-roll when needed.

sections.h2: How do we avoid putting people on the spot?
sections.content: Allow passes, avoid demanding explanations, and do not use responses to pressure someone into sharing personal details.

faq.question: Can I choose an adult category?
faq.answer: No. This page uses one general-audience list.

faq.question: Can the same statement appear twice?
faq.answer: Yes. Every click is an independent selection.

faq.question: Can I submit my own statements?
faq.answer: No. Custom prompts are not supported.
